text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип's angler spirit yearns for a

hundred-squid haul! She swears to battle
to hold
the territory where two ocean
currents meet.
Now, to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп is racing in the Arima Kinen!
And, for
whatever reason, she's fired up
to take on Eishin
Flash as an angler.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
